correctness.rationale: For m unitaries the repeated diagonal pair products yield rank upper bound min(16,m(m−1)+1). The concrete Hermitian Gaussian-rational Cayley witnesses from the actual package, independently reconstructed in Sympy modular arithmetic over F_1009 (sqrt(−1)=469), attained pair-product and Alice/Bob-sum ranks (3,6,6), (7,10,10), (13,16,16), (16,16,16) for m=2..5. Nonzero characteristic-1009 minors imply characteristic-zero nonvanishing, and real-analytic minor zero sets on connected U(4)^m are Haar null. Therefore generic local intersections are only scalar for m≤4 and full M2 for m≥5. Cohen first-measurement criterion gives non-LOCC below threshold; for m≥5 a Hermitian coefficient preimage plus small epsilon positivity gives a real two-outcome first local POVM, not a full LOCC protocol.
